# YPO Education

> > Medical education video library providing comprehensive patient education across orthopaedics, neurology, gynecology, dermatology, ophthalmology, and pain management procedures.

YPO Education (Your Practice Online Education) offers detailed surgical procedure videos and medical condition explanations covering diagnostic techniques like MRI and Visual Acuity Test, common conditions including rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and breast cancer, and specialized treatments across multiple medical specialties.

## Key Topics

- Orthopaedic Surgery
- Arthroscopic Surgery
- Pain Management
- Neuromodulation
- MRI Imaging
- Rheumatoid Arthritis
- Osteoarthritis
- Sports Injury Treatment
- Pediatric Orthopedics
- Breast Cancer Diagnosis
- Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy
- Cataract Surgery
- Dermatological Conditions
- Minimally Invasive Surgery
- Medical Patient Education

## Orthopaedic Surgery Procedures

- [Achilles Tendon Tear Repair Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/foot-ankle/achilles-tendon-tear-repair-t1/video): Achilles tendon rupture repair: Thompson test, RICE method, surgery
- [Shoulder Labrum Reconstruction Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/shoulder/shoulder-labrum-reconstruction-t88/video): Shoulder labrum reconstruction: SLAP tear, Bankart tear arthroscopy
- [Hip Labral Tears Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/hip/labral-tears-of-the-hip-t47/video): Hip labral tear diagnosis with MRI and arthroscopic surgery treatment
- [Chondral Injuries of Hip Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/hip/chondral-injuries-of-hip-t17/video): Hip chondral injuries: FAI, SCFE, microfracture surgery procedures
- [Bunion Surgery Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/foot-ankle/bunion-surgery-t105/video): Bunion (hallux valgus) surgery for arthritis-related foot deformity
- [Common Toe Deformities Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/foot-ankle/common-toe-deformities-t107/video): Toe deformities from arthritis: hammertoe, claw toe, mallet toe, bunion
- [Minimally Invasive Pedicle Screw Instrumentation Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/spine/minimally-invasive-pedicle-screw-instrumentation-t170/video): Minimally invasive pedicle screw spinal fusion with fluoroscopy guidance

## Sports Medicine & Pain Management

- [Medial Collateral Ligament Reconstruction Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/sports-medicine/medial-collateral-ligament-reconstruction-t264/video): MCL reconstruction surgery for knee ligament injury and stability
- [Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/pain-management/patellofemoral-pain-syndrome-t396/video): Patellofemoral pain syndrome (PFPS) knee pain management overview
- [Neuromodulation Video](https://www.ypo.education/pain-management/neuromodulation-t338/video): Neuromodulation: spinal cord & peripheral nerve stimulation for pain
- [Sympathetic Nerve Block Video](https://www.ypo.education/pain-management/sympathetic-nerve-block-t329/video): Cataract types: nuclear, cortical, subcapsular with visual acuity test
- [Headache Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/pain-management/headache-t377/video): Primary & secondary headaches: tension, migraine, cluster types explained

## Neurology Procedures

- [Neurology Procedure Videos](https://www.ypo.education/neurology-15): Neurology category: acoustic neuroma, trigeminal neuralgia, Deep TMS videos
- [Rhizotomy Video](https://www.ypo.education/neurology/rhizotomy-t142/video): Radiofrequency rhizotomy for facet joint pain management procedure

## Women's Health & Gynecology

- [C-section Video](https://www.ypo.education/gynecology/c-section-t251/video): Caesarean section surgical delivery procedure and post-partum care
- [Axillary Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy Video](https://www.ypo.education/general/axillary-sentinel-lymph-node-biopsy-t401/video): Breast cancer sentinel lymph node biopsy procedure with lymphatic mapping

## Ophthalmology & Vision Care

- [Cataract Video](https://www.ypo.education/ophthalmology/cataract-t37/video): Cataract eye condition: lens cloudiness, vision impairment, visual acuity

## Dermatology Treatments

- [Lichen Planus Treatment Video](https://www.ypo.education/dermatology/lichen-planus-t8/video): Lichen planus autoimmune skin disease treatment with CoolGlide Laser

## Pediatric Medicine

- [Avascular Necrosis in Children Video](https://www.ypo.education/orthopaedics/pediatric/avascular-necrosis-in-children-t128/video): Pediatric avascular necrosis (AVN) osteonecrosis diagnosis with MRI/X-ray
- [Puberty](https://www.ypo.education/general/puberty-t159/video): Puberty development: hormonal changes with estrogen and testosterone
